name: Irish Fuel
description: Our house cocktail that put us on the map. Premium Irish whiskey, fresh-squeezed citrus, ginger beer, and a secret splash that makes it dangerously smooth. One gets you loose. Two gets you legendary. Only at Finn McCool's.

name: Bucket Deals
description: Five ice-cold domestics or imports for one price. Perfect for the crew. Available all weekend long.

name: Shot Tower Thursday
description: Stack your shot night right. Jameson, Tullamore, and Bushmills flowing. Pittsburgh's favorite Thursday tradition.

name: Weekend Pitcher Pour
description: Grab a pitcher of Guinness, Smithwick's, or lager and own the table. Best deal on draft in Oakland and South Side.
